description.en: Current Char namespace and explicit Unicode source providers, preserving the earlier zero-dispatch audit as historical evidence. Targeted gates are distinguished from the full CPU suite.
description.ko: 이전 Char 직접 호출 부재 감사를 보존하면서 현재 Core 두 함수와 명시적 Unicode 소스 제공자를 구분한 기록이다. 개별 검사와 CPU 전체 통합 검사를 구분한다.

historical_audit.policy: Preserved unchanged; its zero-dispatch and missing-UCD observations apply only to its original compiler snapshot.

comparison_policy: Catalog pair notation (A,B) is normalized to Tuple<A,B>; this changes no value or ownership semantics.
Source parameter types match every catalog row after whitespace normalization.
The 29 adapted error carriers deliberately use unicode.UnicodeError rather than extending Core CharError.
A source provider does not create a Char namespace compiler binding.
UCD enums and UnicodeVersion/UnicodeNumeric are module-owned source carriers implementing the documented property categories.

namespace_probe.execution_claim: Compile-only spelling/dispatch evidence, separate from source execution gates.

ucd_artifact.data_scope: Scalar property lookup, exact rational numeric values, default isolated-scalar case mappings, canonical/algorithmic names and formal name aliases.

targeted_verification.host_execution: macOS ARM64; no Windows/Linux execution proof is implied by this checkpoint.
targeted_verification.table_initialization: No allocator reachable from property/simple-case/name-lookup APIs; existing compiler module initializer/shutdown wrappers are empty.
targeted_verification.non_UTF8_locale_reproduction: LC_ALL=C PYTHONUTF8=0 PYTHONCOERCECLOCALE=0; passed after explicit UTF8 source/JSON reads.
targeted_verification.full_suite_boundary: This file does not certify completion of the whole CPU catalog or the parent coherent suite.
